evidence: Has the Wallet label and updates descriptor handling in ScriptPubKeyMan and PSBT spending RPCs.
rationale: Populating PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB resolves a concrete interoperability failure where external hardware signers refuse to sign multisig PSBTs. Hardware signers such as the BitBox02 via HWI require these fields to reconstruct multisig setups (closing #27583), providing substantial user-facing value for multisig descriptor wallet setups.
